CREATE FUNCTION CDN.IdentyfikatorPodmiotu (@DaneWe varchar(200), @Typ smallint, @Kierunek smallint, @Format varchar(50), @RodzajDanychWe smallint = 0) RETURNS @Podmiot TABLE ( Akronim varchar(20), Numer int, Typ smallint ) as begin declare @Akronim varchar(20) declare @Numer int
if (@RodzajDanychWe=1) begin if len(@DaneWe) = 26 set @DaneWe = substring(@DaneWe,17,8); else if len(@DaneWe) = 16 set @DaneWe = substring(@DaneWe,7,8) else if len(@DaneWe) = 12 set @DaneWe = substring(@DaneWe,3,8) else begin insert into @Podmiot select '',0,0 return end ; set @Numer = cast(@DaneWe as int)
select @Akronim = isnull(min(A.akronim),''), @Numer = isnull(min(A.numer),0), @typ = isnull(min(A.typ),0) from ( select knt_akronim as akronim, knt_gidnumer as numer, knt_gidtyp as typ from cdn.kntkarty where knt_gidnumer = @Numer ) A
end else begin select @Akronim = @DaneWe, @Numer = isnull(min(A.numer),0), @Typ = isnull(min(A.typ),0) from ( select knt_gidnumer as numer, knt_gidtyp as typ from cdn.kntkarty where knt_akronim =@DaneWe union select prc_gidnumer , prc_gidtyp from cdn.prckarty where prc_akronim =@DaneWe union select urz_gidnumer , urz_gidtyp from cdn.urzedy where urz_akronim = @DaneWe ) A
end
insert into @Podmiot select @Akronim,@Numer,@Typ return end

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.IdentyfikatorPlatnosci (@DaneWe varchar(200), @Waluta varchar(3), @Kierunek smallint, @Format varchar(50)) RETURNS @Platnosc TABLE ( Kwota varchar(200), Waluta varchar(3) ) as begin
insert into @Platnosc select @DaneWe, @Waluta
return end
